name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.39.1: fridge config no longer invents a Nayax port. When a machine has no settings.paymentSerialPort, the field is served as null instead of a guess by door count (double ttyS1, single ttyS4). The port varies per machine, not per type, and fridge v0.56.0 probes both ports itself; a served guess was indistinguishable from an operator override and would have stopped the probe. Apps before v0.56.0 fall back to the same cabinet-count guess when the field is null, so they are unaffected. Cumulative over v6.39.0.
